skills.name: concordia
skills.description: Structured negotiation protocol for AI agents: binding offers, counteroffers, session receipts, portable reputation, and agent discovery via MCP tools. Use when the agent needs to negotiate, make or respond to offers, check counterparty reputation, find trading partners, publish wants or haves, relay messages, propose the protocol to non-Concordia peers, or bridge outcomes to Sanctuary's sovereignty infrastructure. Triggers: negotiation, deal, offer, counter-offer, counteroffer, reputation, want, have, matching, relay, session receipt, attestation, discovery, agent registry, degraded, protocol proposal, sanctuary bridge, commitment, receipt bundle, portable proof.
